historical_source_contract.important_distinction: Exact control count is not Shape.Lines or number of nonempty labels. Three LINEs with a trailing break produce four pen rows, while the cited menu has three selectable labels. Do not rename this field required_rows or infer native selectable rows generically.

proposed_minimal_contract.FitBox: RequiredLineBreaks *int json required_line_breaks,omitempty; pointer distinguishes absent from explicitly0.
proposed_minimal_contract.validation: If present require0<=value<maxStreamBytes/2 (8192/2=4096), and Wrap false. No automatic insertion/deletion/merging of option separators. Existing MaxWidth/MaxLines/AllowPages/MaxBytes and read-only source/pin limits remain.
proposed_minimal_contract.FitRow: LineBreaks *int json line_breaks,omitempty; set only when requested and existing controls native measurement succeeds. Explicit measured0 serializes0; unsupported stays absent.
proposed_minimal_contract.measurement: Sum len(page)-1 for every page in existing Shape.LineWidths. PAGE creates a fresh page and adds zero to this total; trailing, leading and consecutive LINE controls all count. No second token scanner.
proposed_minimal_contract.diagnostics: Retain existing width,height,page,byte diagnostic order; append LINE mismatch diagnostic last. Mismatch sets dedicated row_count_mismatch even when existing overflow facts also occur. A matching exact count leaves existing within_profile/overflow outcome unchanged. Encoding/measurement unsupported remains unsupported without line_breaks.
proposed_minimal_contract.compatibility: Absent/null constraint omits both new fields and leaves all old unambiguous valid report behavior/bytes intact. Whole-profile duplicate-key refusal is a deliberate ambiguity tightening, not byte parity for malformed legacy profiles. Root will establish a precode legacy report baseline and compare; this study did not execute it.
proposed_minimal_contract.new_field_JSON_boundary: Root before-code decision: reuse existing checkJSON with allObjects:true plus aliasesByDepth{3:[required_line_breaks]}. Deliberately tighten duplicate object-key refusal throughout the fit profile; ASCII/Unicode case aliases are specially refused for the new box field only. Existing unrelated old field casefold behavior stays unchanged. Root freezes duplicate canonical/new-field ASCII/Unicode alias and unrelated-root-duplicate raw refusals separately. No new validator, helper or configuration flag.
